Walnut Dumb Waiter c.1880

Fine quality walnut buffet or dumb waiter c.1880. Three 48" x 20" shelves in solid walnut with moulded edges. Shaped apron and brackets below. Joined with slim crisply turned and tapering baluster columns front and rear. Turned feet raised on the original castors. Excellent colour and condition, cleaned and waxed in our worklisting_sources.

Details

  • Width: 48" (122 cm)
  • Height: 42" (106.5 cm)
  • Depth: 20" (51 cm)
  • Year: c.1880
  • Stock Number: 38458
  • Price: £795
